name: SpireBrain Overlay
description: In-game coach: shows the JEV brain's recommendation for the decision in front of you, why, what you did with the last one, and the running agreement rate. Also shows the HP-budget state. When the agent is not reachable the panel says so instead of staying blank. Needs the SpireBrain agent running (python start.py). F8 hides/shows the panel.
